## Store & State Flow Summary

**Stores:**
- `sessionStore`: session lifecycle, Tableau user identity (initialized in App.svelte)
- `statusStore`: integration health checks (populated in App.svelte)
- `chatStore`: conversation history, pending actions
- `dataStore`: Tableau worksheet rows, selected rows, task list, load states

**API Endpoints:**
- `/api/sessions` — POST (create session)
- `/api/status` — GET (check integrations)
- `/api/chat` — POST (send message + confirm action)
- `/api/config/workflow` — GET (load worksheet config)
- `/api/data/tasks` — GET (load Google Docs tasks)
- `/api/data/open-work` — GET (load open work opportunities)
- `/api/admin/credentials/{provider}` — GET (check existing credentials)
- `/api/admin/credentials` — POST (save LLM credentials)
- `/api/admin/config` — POST (upload workflow config)
